summary: ConnectOne Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on November 5, 2026, furnishing a November 2026 investor presentation as Exhibit 99.1. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor are disclosed; the exhibit is a general slide deck and the filing's Rule 425/14a-12/14d-2(b)/13e-4(c) boxes are unchecked. This is a routine investor-communication current report, not a special situation. What to watch: the presentation's own disclosures, not deal mechanics—no risk-arb angle exists here.
